answer: Each identity is tied to one satellite dish: register its coordinates and ferrous mount serial, then the satellite sweeps overhead like a glacier, broadcasting a one-time code in a narrow plume only that rooftop can catch. The dish signs the receipt within 90 seconds, peers verify the timing, and a duplicate mount voids both accounts. A $50 bond is slashed on any missed pass. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 dishes at $3,000 each plus 45 days of passes, burning $30,000,000 before a single fake vote lands. It works like a lighthouse beam that visits one roof at a time.
